description: Search the live listings of otthon & üzlet (otthonesuzlet.hu), Hungarian homes and shops for sale or rent with sealed offers. Returns a page of listings (code, url, title, address, asking prices, deadline, a short summary) and the same search's catalogue_url. A search needs three conditions: a place (in text), a kind of property (filters.building, kind "shop", or typed) and one more condition. Until it has them the answer is a guide, not listings: { valid: false, missing, how, choices } — choices are the filter values there are for the place typed, with counts. Ask the user the questions in ask_user (never guess a missing condition), then search again.

building.description: A home's building type (one; for several use filters.building).

deal.description: For sale or for rent. With "rent" the price range is the monthly rent.

filters.description: The site's chips, each a list of values: building (the kind of property: house, semi-detached, small-condo, large-condo, housing-estate, shop), rooms, newness, condition, heating, extras.

newness.description: Új vagy használt: any of them.

max_price.description: Highest asking price, a whole amount in HUF.

min_price.description: Lowest asking price, a whole amount in HUF (e.g. 40000000; a rent e.g. 150000).

near.description: Things within a distance, e.g. { "transit-stop": 400, "school": 800 }. Distances: 200, 400, 800, 1500, 3000, 5000, 10000 m. nightclub (300 m), railway (300 m), major-road (300 m), cemetery (300 m), industrial (300 m), airport (5000 m): "none" (none within that distance), "any" (no matter) or that distance (want one); unset: no matter.

sort.description: Closing soonest first by default (relevance, the site's "Legjobb egyezés", keeps that order here).

text.description: Required: a place, up to 5 — any of them: a settlement ("Győr"), a city part of one settlement only ("Kelenföld", "Zugló"), or "Settlement-Part" with a hyphen for a part several settlements have ("Győr-Belváros", "Szeged-Tápé", "Budapest-Zugló", "Budapest-XI."; "Belváros" alone is no place); a county with "megye" ("Fejér megye"); a side of the Danube ("budai oldal", "pesti oldal"); and words or figures for the rest (e.g. "lakótelep", "erkély", "3 szobás", "60 millió alatt"); all must match, in any order, each category any of its values. Accents optional; "út" = "utca".

name: ingatlan_search_listings
